name: openblock-desktop
description: DoGoBlock as a self-contained desktop application
author: Openblock.cc Team <contact@openblock.cc> (http://www.openblock.cc/)

scripts.i18n:src: mkdirp translations/core && format-message extract --out-file translations/core/en.json src/main/**.js
scripts.prepare:dependencies: node scripts/prepare-openblock-blocks.js && node scripts/prepare-openblock-link.js && node scripts/prepare-gui-dependencies.js
scripts.start: npm run prepare:dependencies && mkdirp ./dist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 electron-webpack dev --bail --display-error-details --env.minify=false --no-progress
scripts.compile: npm run prepare:dependencies && mkdirp ./dist && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 electron-webpack --bail --display-error-details --env.minify=false --no-progress
scripts.fetch:static: rimraf ./static && mkdirp ./static && git clone https://github.com/educarbr11/openblock-assets-dogo.git static && rimraf ./static/.git
scripts.fetch:all: npm run fetch:drivers && npm run fetch:exts && npm run fetch:firmwares && npm run fetch:tools && npm run fetch:static && npm run fetch:media && npm run prune:desktop && npm run verify:resources
scripts.build:dev: npm run compile && npm run prune:desktop && npm run verify:resources && npm run doBuild -- --mode=dev
scripts.build:dir: npm run compile && npm run prune:desktop && npm run verify:resources && npm run doBuild -- --mode=dir
scripts.build:dist: npm run compile && npm run prune:desktop && npm run verify:resources && npm run doBuild -- --mode=dist
scripts.build:publish: npm run compile && npm run prune:desktop && npm run verify:resources && npm run doBuild -- --mode=publish
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run fetch:all && npm run doBuild -- --mode=dist
scripts.publish: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run fetch:all && npm run doBuild -- --mode=publish
